key_decisions.decision: Keep three energetic petitions and title.
Aravot wilderness chosen with cloud alternative noted; YAH short name preserved.
Rare prosperity term acknowledged, home/release/dryness contrast.
Preserve difficult Sinai phrase and repeated before God.
Hayyah flock/community ambiguity noted, poor provision preserved.
Explicit feminine heralds retained.
Keep doubled flight and woman distributing spoils.
Retain obscure sheepfold/dove scene rather than resolve roles.
Uncertain snow image and divine title retained with note.
Literally mountain of God, preserve doubled Bashan.
Preserve difficult Sinai clause without inserting journey.
Received not gave; retain unsettled final relation.
Unspecified bearing object supplied as burden, noted alternative.
Retain plural deliverances and both divine names.
Preserve violent scalp detail and habitual guilt.
Object them inferred from enemies, repeated return retained.
Keep pinned crush rather than wash, difficult bloody syntax noted.
Source fountain/origin idiom clarified.
Four tribes and rare throng word retained.
Pinned your God not emended command O God; voice shift retained.
Difficult participle chosen active with alternate submission noted; pinned scattered retained.
Uncertain envoys noun and Cush name, no modern Ethiopia equation.
Retain plural sanctuaries and closing blessing.
